title: Release window sprint mosaic and decision fabric
content:
Purpose: quick, portable playbook for a mid-size feature launch where we expect a small-to-medium traffic ramp. This is intentionally compact — meant for the shift lead and the on-call engineers to carry in the pocket. Use the Decision Fabric section to make fast go/no-go calls when signals are noisy.

Context notes and constraints:
- Feature: adaptive routing to cheaper model variants (alpha).
- Traffic slice for launch: 5% initial, ramp to 25% over 48 hours subject to health gates.
- Environments: staging -> canary (internal) -> soft-canary (external 5%) -> ramp.
- Owners: release lead (Aisha P), runtime lead (Ben C), SRE on-call (Marina V).

Preflight quick checklist (T minus 72 to 2 hours)
- [ ] Smoke test vector set validated in staging (PR #2894)
- [ ] Canary config applied to canary cluster, autoscaler min/max set
- [ ] Telemetry: token-level latency, backend GPU utilization, model-fallback rate, error-rate alerting wired
- [ ] Playbook pinned in Slack channel #release-adaptive-routing, message template ready
- [ ] Rollback artifact prepared: previous routing config blob + db flag

Cutover micro-gantt (ASCII view)
Day 0: 09:00 kick, 09:30 smoke, 10:00 soft-canary 5% -> observe
Hours 0-4: hold at 5%, hourly checkpoints
Hours 4-24: ramp 5->10% if signals green, then hourly cadence
Hours 24-48: ramp to 25% if no regressions

Key signals and thresholds (decision fabric)
- Latency p95: green <120ms, amber 120-200ms, red >200ms
- Error rate (5xx): green <0.05%, amber 0.05-0.25%, red >0.25%
- Model-fallback ratio: green <2%, amber 2-8%, red >8%
- Cost-per-token delta vs baseline: green <+5%, amber +5-15%, red >+15%
- Customer-facing errors or support tickets referencing hallucination/regression: any -> immediate review

Decision rules (short)
- All green -> auto-approve next ramp step after 60 minutes of stable telemetry.
- One amber -> extended observation 2 hours and targeted mitigation (throttle, change batch size, reduce seq-len).
- Any red signal -> immediate rollback to previous routing config and declare incident if >=2 reds or single severe customer issue.

Fallout playbook (if red triggered)
1) Rollback: apply rollback blob, set routing flag to previous safe variant.
2) Throttle: reduce external traffic to 1%.
3) Triage: runtime lead + SRE + product owner join quick call, timestamped notes in channel.
4) Post-rollback verification: run core smoke vector set, validate p95 and 5xx back to green.
5) Postmortem stub: capture timeline, signal snapshots, root-cause hypothesis, and mitigation plan within 48 hours.

Comm templates (short)
- Slack to #release-adaptive-routing: "T=0: launching soft-canary 5%. Watch latency p95 and 5xx. Aisha P is lead. If you see red, mention @release-lead and @oncall-sre."
- Support note: "We are rolling a new routing variant to 5% of traffic for the next 48 hours to validate cost/latency. Contact support if you see errors with model responses."

Quick tooling snippets (for shift lead)
- Telemetry queries (examples):
  * latency p95: metrics.query("model.latency.p95", {env: 'canary', route: 'adaptive'})
  * fallback ratio: derived from logs: sum(fallback_events)/sum(total_requests)
- Rollback command (one-liner): infractl routing apply --env=prod --config=rollback-20270508.json

Post-launch items (24-72 hours)
- [ ] Collect prompt set A/B evals for quality regression analysis
- [ ] Cost delta report for the slice, compare with Optimize recommendations
- [ ] Schedule 1-hour postmortem sync if any amber/red events occurred
- [ ] Mark Feature Flag rollout plan in product board and schedule slow ramp to 50% if stable

Open questions / TODOs
- Can we add an automatic hold if model-fallback spikes >4% in a 10-minute window? (Ravi to prototype autosignal)
- Validate that KMS logs are included in canary audit trail for Private customers.
- Confirm customer-facing copy with comms before 09:00 cutover.

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep the decision fabric simple — people in the loop are our control plane, not fancy heuristics.
- If we routinely see amber on cost-per-token, triage quantization profile first.

End of doc. Put this in release binder and pin to canary watchboard.
